article.story: CINCINNATI -- — Tyler Tejada scored 21 points and reserve Tylen Riley scored 15 points and Cincinnati throttled Youngstown State 91-54 on Wednesday night in a game the Bearcats never trailed. MJ Collins Jr. scored 14 points and Riley Allenspach 12 for the Bearcats who shot 33 of 61 (54%) and made 16 of 18 (89%) foul shots. Elijah Perryman distributed a career-high 11 assists in his second-straight at guard. Jaiden Haynes scored 13 points for Youngstown State (2-3). The Penguins made 5 of 25 shots from 3-point range. Cincinnati (4-1) built a 21-11 lead and led 42-24 at halftime. The Bearcats outscored Youngstown State 49-30 in the second half. Cincinnati coach Jerrod Calhoun collected a win against his former employer. Calhoun coached the Penguins from 2017 to 2024. He was the Horizon League Coach of the Year in 2023. Cincinnati is 4-0 in the all-time series dating to 1993. Up next Youngstown State: Hosts William & Mary on Sunday. Cincinnati: Hosts UMass Lowell on Sunday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
